newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt miller pays out 3 pounds for 95/6.
newsitem.headline: Egypt miller pays out 3 pounds for 95/6.

text.p: East Delta Flour Mills said on Thursday it would distribute 3.00 pounds per share for the financial year 95/6.

There was no comparable figure for the previous year's dividend, but the portion of profits allocated for shareholders increased to 23.698 million pounds in 95/96 from 19.342 million pounds in the previous year.
The Egyptian state in September sold off 60.75 percent of East Delta, the second company in the strategic mills sector to leave state control.
East Delta shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange on Thursday at 64.98 pounds up from 62.00 on Wednesday.
